<?php
// api/middleware/AuthMiddleware.php
class AuthMiddleware {
    private $featureFlags;
    private $roleHierarchy = [
        'guest' => 0,
        'user' => 1,
        'moderator' => 2,
        'admin' => 3,
        'superadmin' => 4
    ];

    public function __construct(FeatureFlagService $featureFlags) {
        $this->featureFlags = $featureFlags;
    }

    public function authorize(Request $request, string $requiredRole): bool {
        $token = $request->getHeader('Authorization');
        $session = SessionStore::validate($token);
        if (!$session) {
            return false;
        }

        $userRole = $session->getRole();
        $effectiveRole = $this->computeEffectiveRole($userRole, $session);
        
        return $this->roleHierarchy[$effectiveRole] >= $this->roleHierarchy[$requiredRole];
    }

    private function computeEffectiveRole(string $baseRole, Session $session): string {
        // Feature flag: gradual rollout of new RBAC system
        if ($this->featureFlags->isEnabled('rbac_v2_migration')) {
            return $this->resolveRbacV2Role($baseRole, $session);
        }
        return $baseRole;
    }

    private function resolveRbacV2Role(string $baseRole, Session $session): string {
        $delegations = DelegationStore::getActiveDelegations($session->getUserId());
        
        $maxRole = $baseRole;
        foreach ($delegations as $delegation) {
            if ($this->isDelegationValid($delegation)) {
                $delegatedRole = $delegation->getGrantedRole();
                if ($this->roleHierarchy[$delegatedRole] > $this->roleHierarchy[$maxRole]) {
                    $maxRole = $delegatedRole;
                }
            }
        }
        return $maxRole;
    }

    private function isDelegationValid(Delegation $delegation): bool {
        $now = time();
        $notExpired = $delegation->getExpiresAt() > $now;
        $notRevoked = !$delegation->isRevoked();
        $scopeValid = $this->validateDelegationScope($delegation);
        
        return $notExpired && $notRevoked && $scopeValid;
    }

    private function validateDelegationScope(Delegation $delegation): bool {
        $scope = $delegation->getScope();
        // Check if delegation was created by someone with sufficient privileges
        $grantor = UserStore::getUser($delegation->getGrantorId());
        $grantorRole = $grantor->getRole();
        $grantedRole = $delegation->getGrantedRole();
        
        // Grantor must have higher or equal role than what they're delegating
        // This prevents privilege escalation through delegation chains
        return $this->roleHierarchy[$grantorRole] >= $this->roleHierarchy[$grantedRole];
    }
}

// api/services/FeatureFlagService.php
class FeatureFlagService {
    private $flags = [];
    private $overrides = [];

    public function __construct() {
        $this->loadFlags();
    }

    private function loadFlags(): void {
        $config = json_decode(file_get_contents('/etc/app/feature_flags.json'), true);
        $this->flags = $config['flags'] ?? [];
        $this->overrides = $config['overrides'] ?? [];
    }

    public function isEnabled(string $flagName, ?array $context = null): bool {
        // Check for per-request override header (used in staging/testing)
        if ($this->hasRequestOverride($flagName)) {
            return $this->getRequestOverride($flagName);
        }

        if (!isset($this->flags[$flagName])) {
            return false;
        }

        $flag = $this->flags[$flagName];
        
        if ($flag['rollout_percentage'] === 100) {
            return true;
        }
        if ($flag['rollout_percentage'] === 0) {
            return false;
        }

        // Gradual rollout based on consistent hashing
        $hash = crc32($flagName . ($context['user_id'] ?? ''));
        return ($hash % 100) < $flag['rollout_percentage'];
    }

    private function hasRequestOverride(string $flagName): bool {
        $overrideHeader = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FEATURE_OVERRIDE'] ?? '';
        if (empty($overrideHeader)) {
            return false;
        }
        $overrides = $this->parseOverrideHeader($overrideHeader);
        return isset($overrides[$flagName]);
    }

    private function getRequestOverride(string $flagName): bool {
        $overrideHeader = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FEATURE_OVERRIDE'] ?? '';
        $overrides = $this->parseOverrideHeader($overrideHeader);
        return $overrides[$flagName] === 'true';
    }

    private function parseOverrideHeader(string $header): array {
        $result = [];
        $pairs = explode(',', $header);
        foreach ($pairs as $pair) {
            $parts = explode('=', trim($pair), 2);
            if (count($parts) === 2) {
                $result[trim($parts[0])] = trim($parts[1]);
            }
        }
        return $result;
    }
}

// api/controllers/AdminController.php
class AdminController {
    private $auth;

    public function __construct(AuthMiddleware $auth) {
        $this->auth = $auth;
    }

    public function deleteUser(Request $request): Response {
        if (!$this->auth->authorize($request, 'admin')) {
            return new Response(403, ['error' => 'Insufficient privileges']);
        }

        $targetUserId = $request->getParam('user_id');
        UserStore::deleteUser($targetUserId);
        return new Response(200, ['status' => 'deleted']);
    }

    public function promoteUser(Request $request): Response {
        if (!$this->auth->authorize($request, 'superadmin')) {
            return new Response(403, ['error' => 'Insufficient privileges']);
        }

        $targetUserId = $request->getParam('user_id');
        $newRole = $request->getParam('role');
        UserStore::updateRole($targetUserId, $newRole);
        return new Response(200, ['status' => 'promoted']);
    }
}
